name: Bruno
summary: Bruno is an open source API client that stores collections as plain text files, so they can be versioned in Git. The Open Source plan is free. Pro costs $6 and Ultimate $11 per user a month, billed annually. The pricing page shows dollar figures without naming a currency.

facts.text: Bruno stores collections as plain text files on the filesystem, so they can be versioned with Git and reviewed like code.
The bru run command runs a single request, a folder or a collection. Its test reports can be written in formats including JSON, JUnit and HTML.
An environment can inherit from one parent environment of the same scope. The child's own values override the parent's.
The Open Source plan allows public Git providers only, 2 workspaces and 5 OpenAPI syncs a month.

plans.name: Open Source
plans.notes: Public Git providers only, 2 workspaces, 5 OpenAPI syncs a month, community support

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Billed annually. Private Git providers, unlimited workspaces and unlimited OpenAPI syncs. Credit card payment only. The page does not name a currency

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Billed annually. Adds PO and invoice payment and a 24-hour support SLA. 14-day free trial without a card. The page does not name a currency
